context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 67 verified Travel Context feature. Key findings: (1) Backend POST /api/ai/travel-plan generates flight_info (outbound/return with flight_number, airports, times), hotel_info (name, address, area, phone), and airport_to_hotel (best_option, alternative, tip). (2) Backend POST /api/ai/geocode-plan returns special_pins object with airport and hotel entries containing lat/lng coordinates. (3) Backend POST /api/ai/travel-plan/refine preserves flight_info, hotel_info, airport_to_hotel from previous_plan. (4) Frontend TravelContext component renders flight info, hotel info, and transport info with data-testid attributes. (5) Frontend SmartMap sidebar shows 'Referências' section with airport and hotel entries using data-testid='sidebar-special-airport' and 'sidebar-special-hotel'. (6) SmartMap renders airport marker (blue) and hotel marker (orange) on Leaflet map. (7) Dashed polyline between airport and hotel is rendered when both are geocoded. Note: Rate limiting (5 requests/hour) may affect testing - use /api/ai/travel-plan/reset-limit to clear.
